label: DisasterReady India - Mobile Family Safety & Check-in
title: DisasterReady India - Mobile Family Safety & Check-in
prompt: Mobile Family Status Registry & I Am Safe Check-in (G3-G5 /prepare/family, /prepare/safe): "Tell my family I am safe" primary action with one-tap SMS/WhatsApp broadcast to saved emergency contacts. Family safety plan summary: designated high-ground meeting point (Ward 9 Community Hall / Sonpur Shelter), registered family members with status badges (Safe: circle-check, Needs Help: triangle-exclamation). Missing person search & report queue with "Checked by staff" official badge. Go-bag offline survival checklist with checkboxes (Torch, Drinking Water, Medicines, Documents, Radio, Power bank). No decorative cards, authoritative government styling.
